harness.reproduce: python3 run_differential.py <worktree> <base-commit> <transcripts-out.json> [--mutants <out.json>]: it copies the harness to apps/three-surface-poc/src/zz-main-differential.test.ts, writes the base commit main.ts to zz-main-old.ts, runs npx vitest run on the harness, and deletes both afterwards; they are never committed.
harness.method: Per scenario the old script runs as a module (top level, process.argv, process.stdout, process.cwd, process.stdin, signals), the new exported main in poc-main.ts runs with a fake PocIo, and the new entry main.ts runs as a module the same way as the old script, all against the same mocked collaborators (git observation, production model builder, daemon). The three transcripts (stdout, stderr, exit code, ordered collaborator calls, daemon options and route list, post-start route responses, close count, thrown error) must be deeply equal.

survivorsExplained.observer-read-at-process-cwd: equivalent under the harness: it fixes process.cwd and io.cwd to the same value because the composition root defines io.cwd as process.cwd(); killed by main.test.ts, which gives the two different values
survivorsExplained.observation-instant-from-clock: equivalent under the harness: Date is faked to the instant io.now returns, and the composition root defines io.now as new Date().toISOString(); killed by main.test.ts, which injects a distinct clock
